labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Participants must be suspected to have previously untreated acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS).
Participants must not have received prior anti-cancer therapy for AML or MDS.
Participants must not have a prior or concurrent malignancy that requires concurrent anti-cancer therapy

labels.note: Newly diagnosed untreated AML (IDH2+), unfit for intensive chemo; myeloMATCH screening includes older AML tiers.
